_comment: Copy to config/genai.json. Each purpose names a provider; 'procedural' needs no model and is always the fallback. Providers sharing a 'gpu' group run one model at a time: the engine unloads one (llama.cpp router /models/unload, ComfyUI /free) before using another.

comfy._comment: Places, mist and every asset are painted with Krea 2 here. Assets (characters, creatures, objects, icons) use the workflow below: Krea paints the subject on the chroma-key backdrop the prompt writer picked and the cutter model (BiRefNet, ComfyUI's built-in Remove Background) marks it, in one job; the engine cuts it out against the known backdrop and scores the cut. Models: diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors, background_removal/birefnet.safetensors (Comfy-Org/BiRefNet).

openai._comment: Hosted text and structured output. Put OPENAI_API_KEY in .env at the repository root. 'flex' is half price; busy capacity is waited out. 'strict' enforces the schema while decoding.

openai-decide._comment: OpenAI decisions endpoint (/v1/decisions), e.g. for image.check.

openai-live._comment: Play-time calls (NPC conversations): the standard tier, for low latency.

openai-stt._comment: Speech to text for talking to people (OPENAI_API_KEY from .env). gpt-transcribe also works.

world.design._comment: strongModel: asked once, only when a painted place still cannot be used after Luna's reading check, before it is repainted. Defaults to gpt-6.1-sol on an OpenAI provider; null turns it off. It is charged at its OpenAI list price ($2 input, $0.10 cached, $10 output per million tokens; flex halves them); a provider can override that with "modelPricing": {"gpt-6.1-sol": {"inputPerM", "cachedPerM", "outputPerM"}}.

image.prompt._comment: Writes each asset's Krea prompt and picks its chroma-key backdrop (green, blue or magenta) and, for creatures, the view (front or side).

image.check._comment: Judges each painting's content (subject, framing, pose). The cut itself is scored without a model, against the known backdrop.

spending._comment: Daily budgets for paid (cloud) models in dollars: per player (an administrator can set each player's own on the Users page) and for the whole server. Administrators are unlimited unless given their own budget. Providers may set "pricing": {"inputPerM", "cachedPerM", "outputPerM"}; OpenAI providers default to gpt-6-luna prices.

animation._comment: Actor animation (docs/world-art.md, Characters in motion): a 3D model, rig and clip sheets in eight directions per character and creature, made in the background after the art. Paths are this machine's. python: one with numpy, scipy and Pillow (ComfyUI's embedded Python). library: Quaternius' Universal Animation Library (CC0, the glTF from its Unreal-Godot folder). skintokens (optional, for animals and other bodies): a SkinTokens checkout with its own venv; device cuda takes the GPU alone (about 14 GB), cpu takes 12-18 minutes per creature. Leave this block out to keep still images.
